source: Transformer Engine exposes several strategies, including delayed scaling, current per-tensor scaling, and blockwise variants. A typical scale derives from an observed absolute maximum (amax) and the maximum representable ZXNAME0000XZ value, with margins/history depending on the recipe.
zh: Transformer Engine 公开了多种策略，包括延迟缩放、当前每张量缩放和块式变体。典型的比例源自观察到的绝对最大值 (amax) 和最大可表示 ZXNAME0000XZ 值，其边际/历史记录取决于配方。
